title: Standing Order: Cut the Take
description: Coyle keeps a standing bounty on Syndicate gunsels — every one you drop is a shift the racket can't run. It never closes and it never runs dry; bring him a tally whenever your knuckles are sore and he'll pay it out of the ward's discretionary purse. A rolling bonus objective for the long climb: not a story, just a good reason to keep hunting when the quest board's gone quiet.
location_hint: Ashmoor High Street — wherever the Gunsels post up.
